curator: manual curation over official sources (see evidence excerpts)

evidence.title: MCP specification (2025-06-18)
evidence.excerpt: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that enables seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools.

evidence.title: MCP architecture
evidence.excerpt: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) follows a client-host-server architecture where each host can run multiple client instances.

evidence.title: MCP authorization
evidence.excerpt: The Model Context Protocol provides authorization capabilities at the transport level, enabling MCP clients to make requests to restricted MCP servers.

evidence.title: MCP lifecycle
evidence.excerpt: The MCP specification defines a client-server lifecycle covering initialization, operation and shutdown.

evidence.title: MCP server tools
evidence.excerpt: MCP servers can provide tools that can be invoked by the client.

evidence.title: MCP server resources
evidence.excerpt: MCP servers can expose resources to clients.

evidence.title: MCP server prompts
evidence.excerpt: MCP servers can expose prompt templates to clients.

evidence.title: Official MCP Registry
evidence.excerpt: The Official MCP Registry: discover Model Context Protocol servers.

evidence.title: About the MCP Registry
evidence.excerpt: The MCP Registry is the official centralized metadata repository for publicly accessible MCP servers, backed by major trusted contributors to the MCP ecosystem.

evidence.title: Introducing the MCP Registry
evidence.excerpt: registry.modelcontextprotocol.io launched as the official MCP Registry in preview on September 8, 2025.

evidence.title: modelcontextprotocol/servers
evidence.excerpt: The modelcontextprotocol/servers repository hosts MCP server implementations, including reference servers such as filesystem, git, GitHub, Postgres, SQLite, Puppeteer, fetch, memory and time.

evidence.title: github/github-mcp-server
evidence.excerpt: The GitHub MCP Server lets AI agents interact with GitHub: repositories, code search, issues and more.

evidence.title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol
evidence.excerpt: Anthropic introduced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that connects AI assistants to data sources and tools.
